fusions.name: Decree of Judgement
fusions.desc: Hurls a bolt of authority into the first enemy it meets, dealing 40 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Halt Order
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 12 damage and is stunned for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Writ of Sanctuary
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Command Presence
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next spell deals 40% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
